decisive_items: Regular narrow QRS tachycardia (QRS duration, 60 milliseconds) at a ventricular rate of 103-125 beats/min
Regular P waves evident marching onto QRS complexes at a rate of 100-125 beats/min with mean cycle length of 517.16 milliseconds with varying PR intervals
jugular venous pulsations revealed regular cannon waves
response.rationale: The regular narrow QRS tachycardia is consistent with a supraventricular tachycardia, while the regular P waves with varying PR intervals, cannon waves, and variable first heart sound indicate AV dissociation rather than AVNRT.

rejected.why: AVNRT is not supported because the ECG shows regular P waves with varying PR intervals and the examination shows cannon waves and variable S1, findings more consistent with AV dissociation than AVNRT.
